implementation: custom Matplotlib renderer; supplied asymmetric interval geometry is outside the five core renderer families
palette: EasyViz coordinated blue and coral; an explicit design adaptation, not recovered author colors
mark_outline_policy: All estimate dots and legend symbols are borderless fills. Confidence intervals use uncapped segments; exact supplied endpoints are retained. A lighter dashed zero guide and a quiet axis support the primary estimates.

semantics.interval: Supplied asymmetric 95% confidence interval; endpoints used directly
semantics.cohorts: Independent participants; matching terms do not imply paired participants
semantics.n: Independent participant count, descriptive only; no size or weighting mapping
semantics.domain: Supplied descriptive metadata; preserve contiguous source groups
semantics.statistics: No statistics recomputed; no fitting, weighting, aggregation, or hypothesis testing
